d: Penhall investigates at a high school and encounters a student who reminds him of Jack Archer. Archer made his life difficult back in elementary school. When he shares this incident with his Jump Street colleagues, everyone has their own story to tell about it.

st: The dreaded retunr of Russel Buckins
d: Hanson is temporarily suspended from duty because his friend Russell Buckins published an article that portrays the Jump Street program poorly. To restore his reputation, Hanson must find Russell so he can speak for him before the inquiry committee.

Soldier Weaver is pressured so hard by his training officer Wilcox that he deserts. Wilcox asks Captain Fuller to bring Weaver back before he is officially considered a deserter and faces worse trouble.

Booker infiltrates Christine's friend circle to take down a dealer. When the clique realizes there's a snitch among them, Booker shifts the suspicion to Christine's boyfriend Bobby, who is then killed. To solve the murder, Booker gets closer to Christine, who falls for him.

t: Nine Lives of Christmas- Eine samtige Bescherung
d: After a stray cat adopts Zachary, he meets Marilee and realizes the single life is not as fulfilling as he thought it was.

Bakery owner Kate (Melissa Joan Hart) is struggling with Christmas stress – then her boyfriend, the local Santa Claus, leaves her! Just as she's about to give up on the holidays, a little miracle happens... Heartwarming Christmas comedy!
